facts.claim: BCPL says Hebron has a computer desk that raises and lowers at the push of a button. It describes its buildings as having wide aisles and allows borrowed wheelchairs inside and on library grounds, including the Hebron Storywalk; route measurements are not supplied.

facts.claim: The amphitheater is outdoors and uncovered; bring blankets or chairs to events there.

facts.claim: The library welcomes a phone call in advance to discuss other accommodations. Every branch has translation devices for talking with patrons who don't speak English.
facts.quote: Every branch also has translation devices to improve communication with non-English-speaking patrons. And of course, a phone call in advance to discuss additional accommodations is always welcome.

facts.claim: Place holds through BCPL’s website or app, choose Hebron, and wait for the ready notification. Use the drive-thru and bring your library card.

Remember to bring your library card for a smooth transaction.
At the Hebron Branch and Walton Branch, skip curbside and pull up to the convenient drive-thru.

facts.claim: Hebron lists four study rooms, each for up to four people, with no room charge. Reserve by phone or in person only, or request a room at the customer service desk. All requests are subject to our Study Room Policy .

facts.claim: BCPL offers home delivery to Boone County residents of any age who cannot visit because of a temporary or permanent physical limitation or lack of transportation. Staff arrange delivery and collection every four to six weeks; weather or mechanical problems can cancel visits. Register through Outreach or call 859-292-3394.
quote: All Boone County residents - regardless of age - are eligible for outreach services if they are unable to visit the Library due to a temporary or permanent physical limitation and to those who lack transportation.

Our Outreach Services staff will contact you to discuss the types of materials you like and to make arrangements for delivery. Materials will be delivered and picked-up every four to six weeks until you no longer need this service.
Visits may be canceled for inclement weather or mechanical issues.
Complete the registration form linked below or call 859-292-3394 .

facts.claim: BCPL’s currently linked Study Room Policy, approved October 2023, does not require a library card to reserve a room. Procedures, time limits and availability vary by branch; call the branch before relying on a room. One customer may reserve one study room at a time.
quote: Approved 10/2023
Study rooms vary across the system; call the specific branch to learn about specific reservation procedures, time limits, and availability.
A library card is not required for reservation.
A single customer may only reserve 1 study room at a time.

facts.claim: Under the linked October 2023 policy, study-room use must finish 15 minutes before closing. A reservation may be given to someone waiting after a 15-minute no-show; library activities take priority and reservations may be changed or cancelled. Do not rely on a study room as a guaranteed retreat.
quote: Approved 10/2023
All room usage must conclude 15 minutes prior to the Library's posted closing time.
If a person/group does not show up for their scheduled reservation of the study room, after 15 minutes the Library holds the right to give the room away to a customer who might be waiting.
Library sponsored activities take precedence over non-Library uses of the study rooms.
The Library reserves the right to change or cancel any study room reservation if circumstances at the Library so demand, including room reassignment based upon size of the group.
